== Summary ==
[[Dan Sokol]] with [[Team Albany]] at [[DecipherCon 1999]] (Wild Card day, 11 November 1999). Photo: Decipher. Cropped from [[:File:Team Albany DecipherCon 1999.jpg]] (yellow Team Albany shirt, third from left, no cap).

Identification: [[Matt Sokol]] identified the man in the yellow Team Albany shirt, third from left, as his brother Dan Sokol (personal communication to Bill Bisco, 27 October 2026).
